card.name: Seochanit Shop
card.description: Sells lamps, chairs and bookshelves. A model negotiates the price.

skills.description: Name lamp, chair or bookshelf, then offer an integer price on the same task. A counteroffer, receipt or rejection follows. Long text price offers are model-read; current ask is in Task and Message metadata.ask.
